traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are satisfied. The require-branch-annotation rule is implemented with per-branch-type visitors that enforce @story and @req on all significant branch constructs, using a helper module to associate comments with branches and parse annotations. Configuration via branchTypes is fully supported, including clear error reporting for invalid values. Tests comprehensively cover valid and invalid branches, autofix behavior, and configuration error handling, and they all pass in the current Jest run. The rule is documented with configuration examples and integrated into the plugin’s recommended and strict presets, and the error messaging clearly indicates which annotation is missing, fulfilling the user experience and documentation criteria.
